title: 资管CIO Adam Gold：CEO人选决定AI芯片龙头命运？
speaker: Adam Gold

segments.en: Does it matter who the CEO is? I mean, does the business, is the business robust enough that it would survive?
segments.zh: CEO是谁重要吗？业务本身是否足够稳健，能挺过去？

segments.en: And obviously they need to be careful, obviously, to know who they pick.
segments.zh: 显然他们需要谨慎，清楚自己选的是谁。

segments.en: But should it be agnostic, really, of who leads this company?
segments.zh: 但真的应该与谁领导这家公司无关吗？

segments.en: No, not agnostic at all. You need to find someone extremely technically capable.
segments.zh: 不，绝非无关。你需要找一个技术能力极强的人。

segments.en: I mean, so the intel example many years ago was a perfectly relevant one.
segments.zh: 多年前英特尔的例子就非常贴切。

segments.en: Same industry. Bob Swan was a private equity investor.
segments.zh: 同一行业。鲍勃·斯旺是私募市场参与者。

segments.en: He came on as CFO. The CEO got picked out because of a sexual relationship with an employee, like exact same situation.
segments.zh: 他出任CFO。CEO因与员工有性关系被选下台，情况一模一样。

segments.en: They were having technical challenges, delays against AMD.
segments.zh: 他们面临技术挑战，在AMD面前出现延迟。

segments.en: NVIDIA was a competitor. We actually short intel against other companies as a paratrade.
segments.zh: 英伟达是竞争对手。我们实际上做空英特尔，作为对其他公司的配对交易。

segments.en: It worked out for almost a decade. But they put the CFO in place.
segments.zh: 这个策略奏效了近十年。但他们让CFO上位了。

segments.en: And that has led to them. Their stock almost go bankrupt.
segments.zh: 这导致他们股价几乎大幅波动。

segments.en: And the government had to put money in at $20 because the CFO led them so far behind the technology scale.
segments.zh: 政府不得不以20美元注资，因为CFO让他们在技术上远远落后。

segments.en: And so it's very important they put someone who's very technically capable from the design side.
segments.zh: 所以非常重要的是，他们需要从设计端找一个技术能力很强的人。

segments.en: All of the NVIDIA's biggest customers were all designed in their own custom ASICs.
segments.zh: 英伟达所有最大客户都设计了自己的定制ASIC。

segments.en: Jensen would say that it's about who has the best performance in the future.
segments.zh: 黄仁勋会说，关键在于未来谁的性能最好。

segments.en: We're smoking with designers, engineers who work at software.
segments.zh: 我们与设计师、软件工程师交流。

segments.en: You know, semiconductor companies on software side, a hardware side.
segments.zh: 半导体公司在软件和硬件方面都是如此。

segments.en: Their roadmap was three to six years in terms of publicly disclosed.
segments.zh: 他们公开披露的路线图是三到六年。

segments.en: You should double that internally in terms of six to 12 years of how far out the internal development is going.
segments.zh: 内部应该翻倍，即六到十二年的内部开发进度。

segments.en: And so the pipeline is very strong here. Publicly three to six years, privately six to 12 year roadmap.
segments.zh: 所以这里的管线非常强。公开是三到六年，私下是六到十二年路线图。

segments.en: road map, you need someone who has supply chain experience, who can continue to grow all of the logistical issues.
segments.zh: 路线图，你需要有供应链经验的人，能够继续解决所有物流问题。

segments.en: And so it's not just anyone, I would say it's not agnostic who they appoint, but if they put someone capable, who is knowledge of the industry, I think the road map is very
segments.zh: 所以不是随便谁，我认为他们任命的人不是无关紧要的，但如果他们任命有能力、了解行业的人，我认为路线图非常

segments.en: strong. And then it's about, especially with PowerShell and the data center concerns, it's really
segments.zh: 强劲。然后关键是，特别是考虑到PowerShell和数据中心的担忧，这真的
